title: Honsha station built properly, from every side
caption: The station and its platform shed are now one Blender model, finished on every side. The station has brick walls on a stone plinth, stone corners and bands, a window with a sill, head and steel frame in every opening, canopies over the exit and the glass front, and a roof with its plant, rails and the name board. The shed has one track down the middle with a platform on each side, matching what you see from the train. It has a curved roof on columns, a glazed back wall on the sea side, a railing on the town side, a glazed north end with buffers, and stairs down to the covered walkway. The station still fades when it hides Eric.

sections.title: Seen from the sea, from behind and from above
sections.caption: These are the sides the play camera never showed, which had been left unfinished.

sections.title: Walking round it at eye height
The play camera
sections.caption: On the court the station stands whole at the bottom left. At its door it fades, and the security room shows as a cut-away as before.

sections.title: The train arriving
sections.caption: The game's arrival shows the train's own platforms from above. That view is unchanged, and the shed now has the same layout.
